title: Directory renames, 9 October 2026 / 目录改名

transforms.paths: The ordered rules applied to the whole text. A rule matches a whole path component after a path boundary (start, ../, ./, a GitHub /main/ prefix or the repository root) and never inside an evidence-copy path.
transforms.links: The same rules applied only to Markdown link targets on lines that do not quote Ren.
transforms.none: Text unchanged; the file changed only through carried hashes.

preserved: Original bytes kept: sources/ (except link targets in the directive register), drafts/, output/, reading notes, handoffs, preservation history and dated inventories; every directory named before, after, incoming, snapshot, frozen, legacy, history, archive, retained, revalidation, checks, runs, originals, verification, revisions, development* or pre-import; Lean sources and patches; and JSON other than records, catalogue data, goals and configuration.
